albums.title: CINEMA
albums.synopsis: After their previous known EPs — Superclean Vol. I and Superclean Vol. II — CINEMA marks the official debut album of the LA duo The Marías, featuring tracks in English and Spanish and being inspired by classic films and directors that María and Josh grew up watching, including Pedro Almodóvar and Wes Anderson.

tracks.title: All I Really Want Is You

albums.title: Submarine
albums.synopsis: Submarine is an album that represents solitude and exploration. we wrote it in the throws of heartbreak, my mind spiraling at each turn, my vision a blur. no one noticed, but there were moments during the writing process where i felt like my mind was underwater and where i couldn’t hear anything except for the echo of my own thoughts. i’ve come out on the other side of that headspace with more clarity than ever and with a project that i’ve never been more proud of.

albums.title: Superclean Vol. I
albums.synopsis: Superclean Vol. 1 is the debut EP of the LA based band “The Marias” formed of Maria — Lead Vocals/Guitar Josh Conway — Producer/Drums/Vocals Carter Lee — Bass/Vocals Jesse Perlman — Lead Guitar/Vocals Edward James — Keys/Vocals

albums.title: Thriller
albums.synopsis: Michael Jackson’s Thriller was not only the biggest album of the 1980s but it is the biggest-selling album of all time with more than 70 million copies sold worldwide. This album turned MJ into a megastar and led him straight to the throne and crown as the King of Pop.

tracks.title: The Girl is Mine (with Paul McCartney)

albums.title: Off the Wall
albums.synopsis: The emergence of Michael Jackson as an adult solo superstar began at the age of 21 with the release of his breakthrough fifth album, 1979’s Off the Wall. This album began the working relationship between Jackson and producer Quincy Jones—a duo that would go on to produce a few hits after this project.

albums.title: Fancy That
albums.synopsis: Fancy That marks PinkPantheress' second mixtape alongside her debut mixtape to hell with it

albums.title: to hell with it
albums.synopsis: to hell with it is the debut mixtape from English singer, songwriter and record producer PinkPantheress, following her introduction into the music scene with a string of viral singles on the video-sharing social media platform TikTok.

albums.title: Sweet Boy
albums.synopsis: Including a new arrangement of tracks filled with some of his most beloved tracks, Sweet Boy releases as a full album with both of the tracklists of the previous parts and the last singles.

albums.title: Malcolm Todd
albums.synopsis: Malcolm Todd is the debut studio album by the American singer-songwriter and musician Malcolm Todd. The album is primarily an alternative R&B and indie pop album. The album is produced by Todd along with his bandmate Jonah Cochran and Charlie Ziman. It contains funky guitar riffs, drum beats, and electronic synthesizers

albums.title: Currents
albums.synopsis: Aptly titled, Tame Impala’s third studio record Currents is a warm sonic wave straight from Australian waters, combining neo-psychedelia and alternative dance. Sometimes the wave washes over you, and sometimes you find yourself surfing atop it. The album marks Tame Impala’s venture deeper into the ever-growing world of electronic music, but doesn’t stray too far from their rock roots.

tracks.title: The Less I Know The Better

albums.title: Random Access Memories
albums.synopsis: Daft Punk’s fourth and final studio album, Random Access Memories, comes eight years after Human After All.

albums.title: EP III
albums.synopsis: EP III the third and final installment in Yumi Zouma’s series of EPs that began in 2014. This new record finds the international act stronger than ever, sculpting effortless atmospheres, winsome hooks and stadium-ready finishes.

albums.title: Good Kid, M.A.A.D City
albums.synopsis: good kid, m.A.A.d city is Kendrick Lamar’s major label debut. This concept album depicts a day in the life of a 17-year-old Lamar as he rides around Compton in his mom’s minivan.

tracks.title: Sing About Me, I'm Dying of Thirst

albums.title: To Pimp A Butterfly
albums.synopsis: To Pimp a Butterfly is the third studio album by the American rapper Kendrick Lamar. Primarily a hip-hop album, To Pimp a Butterfly incorporates numerous other musical styles spanning the history of African-American music, most prominently jazz, funk, and soul. Lyrically, it features political commentary and personal themes concerning African-American culture, racial inequality, depression, and institutional discrimination.

albums.title: In Rainbows
albums.synopsis: In Rainbows is the seventh studio album by the English rock band Radiohead. It was first released independently on 10 October 2007 as a digital download that customers could order for whatever price they saw fit, including for free. Without a doubt, In Rainbows is one of Radiohead’s most orchestral records. The warm arrangements and sounds gather to create sonic emotions that raised the bar for art rock.

albums.title: OK Computer
albums.synopsis: OK Computer is the third studio album by the English rock band Radiohead. The lyrics depict a dystopian world fraught with rampant consumerism, social alienation, technological anxiety and political corruption, while also exploring themes of transport, conformity, paranoia, death, modern British life and globalisation. In this capacity, OK Computer is said to have prescient insight into the mood of 21st-century life. Radiohead used unconventional production techniques, including natural reverberation, and no audio separation.

albums.title: Immunity
albums.synopsis: Immunity is Clairo’s debut studio album. Immunity contains lots of intimate tracks about her coming of age, and releasing her feelings for women. The album’s title was influenced by being diagnosed with juvenile rheumatoid arthritis, an autoimmune disease that’s physically demanding – particularly on an internationally touring musician.

albums.title: CHROMAKOPIA
albums.synopsis: CHROMAKOPIA marks Tyler, The Creator’s eighth studio album, breaking his long-lived two-year project release window on odd-numbered years. Throughout CHROMAKOPIA, Tyler, The Creator battles with the shades of maturity, as the once colorful glee of ambition and youth withers away with his maturity.

tracks.title: Hope You Find Your Way Home

albums.title: CALL ME IF YOU GET LOST
albums.synopsis: CALL ME IF YOU GET LOST is the seventh studio album by the American rapper and producer Tyler, the Creator. The album marks a departure from the lighter and more soulful aesthetics of Tyler's previous releases Igor and Flower Boy in favor of bold beats and raw rhymes reminiscent of his earlier work. Genres on the album span hip-hop, pop, jazz, soul and reggae.

tracks.title: SWEET/I THOUGHT YOU WANTED TO DANCE

albums.title: Short n' Sweet
albums.synopsis: Short n' Sweet is Sabrina Carpenter’s sixth album. The album explores Carpenter's love life and her perspectives on 2020s dating. Its title is a reference to the emotional impact of her shortest romantic relationships, as well as her short stature and the album's brief runtime.

albums.title: Manning Fireworks
albums.synopsis: Manning Fireworks is the fourth solo album by American musician MJ Lenderman. The record is an insight into Lenderman's 'frank observations on the intersection of wit and sadness' that transfers 'punchlines' and 'rusted-wire guitar solos' from previous works and presents a 'new sincerity' and perspective through 'his warped lens'.

tracks.title: You Don't Know the Shape I'm In

albums.title: Two Hands
albums.synopsis: Two Hands is the fourth studio album by the American band Big Thief. Two Hands sees Big Thief take on 'powerful and gritty' grunge-folk. It also works in indie rock, yielding a 'crisper [and] more jagged' sound

albums.title: Bright Future
albums.synopsis: Bright Future is the sixth solo studio album by Adrianne Lenker. Recorded straight to tape with a small group of close confidants, the Big Thief singer's latest solo album is free-flowing and intuitive, reveling in the space between spontaneity and impermanence.

albums.title: abysskiss
albums.synopsis: abysskiss is the third solo studio album by Adrianne Lenker, released on October 5, 2018 through Saddle Creek Records. Recorded in a week at Panoramic House in West Marin, California with producer Luke Temple, the album consists of ten intimate folk songs conceived while touring with Big Thief, exploring themes of mortality, love, birth, and nature through strikingly vivid imagery.

albums.title: The Great Impersonator
albums.synopsis: The Great Impersonator is the fifth studio album by American singer Halsey. The album focuses on exploring Halsey's authenticity and relationships and her interpretation of their resonance with various contexts.

albums.title: If I Can't Have Love, I Want Power
albums.synopsis: If I Can't Have Love, I Want Power is the fourth studio album by American singer Halsey, released on August 27, 2021. Produced by Trent Reznor and Atticus Ross, the album is a bold concept record inspired by Halsey's experience of pregnancy and motherhood. It pushes creative boundaries by blending alternative and industrial pop with themes of feminine power, identity, and autonomy.

tracks.title: I Am Not a Woman, I'm a God

albums.title: Melodrama
albums.synopsis: Melodrama is the second studio album by New Zealand singer-songwriter Lorde. Melodrama is built around Antonoff's signature production, which incorporates drums, synths, layered vocals and straightforward hooks.

albums.title: Pure Heroine
albums.synopsis: Pure Heroine is the debut studio album by New Zealand singer-songwriter Lorde, released on September 27, 2013. An electronica, electropop, and dream pop album with minimalist production, deep bass and programmed beats, it explores themes of youth and critiques mainstream culture. The album received widespread critical acclaim and earned Lorde two Grammy Awards, including Song of the Year for its lead single 'Royals'.

albums.title: Blonde
albums.synopsis: Blonde is the second studio album by the American singer Frank Ocean. Blonde features an abstract, atmospheric sound in comparison to Ocean's previous work, and utilizes a variety of unconventional musical elements.

albums.title: channel ORANGE
albums.synopsis: channel ORANGE is the debut studio album by the American R&B singer-songwriter Frank Ocean. channel ORANGE draws on electro-funk, pop-soul, jazz-funk, and psychedelic styles, as well as nonmusical sounds such as film dialogue and ambient noise that function as interludes.

albums.title: Rumours
albums.synopsis: Rumours is the eleventh studio album by the British and American rock band Fleetwood Mac. Recorded with the intention of making 'a pop album' that would expand on the commercial success of the 1975 album Fleetwood Mac, Rumours contains a mix of electric and acoustic instrumentation, accented rhythms, guitars, and keyboards, with lyrics concerning personal and often troubled relationships.

albums.title: Tango in the Night
albums.synopsis: Tango in the Night is the fourteenth studio album by Fleetwood Mac, released on April 13, 1987. The final studio album to feature the classic Rumours lineup, it blends pop rock and soft rock with synthesizers, drum machines, and Lindsey Buckingham's intricate studio production. The album was a major commercial success, reaching number one in the UK and spawning four US top 20 singles.

albums.title: Behind the Mask
albums.synopsis: Behind the Mask is the fifteenth studio album by Fleetwood Mac, released on April 9, 1990. The first album without guitarist Lindsey Buckingham, it introduced new members Billy Burnette and Rick Vito, bringing blues and rockabilly influences to the band's sound. Though not as commercially successful as its predecessor, the album debuted at number one in the UK and was certified Gold in the United States.

tracks.title: In the Back of My Mind

albums.title: CTRL
albums.synopsis: Ctrl is the debut studio album by American singer-songwriter SZA. The album tests the borders of traditional R&B, drawing influences from trap and indie rock. The album contains a precise sonic methodology, with a fluent production, containing influences from pop, hip-hop and electronic genres.

albums.title: SOS
albums.synopsis: SOS is the second studio album by American singer-songwriter SZA, released on December 9, 2022. Primarily an R&B album with influences from hip-hop and pop, it samples soul, gospel, jazz and melodic rap while blending surf rock, grunge, and lo-fi beats. The album received widespread critical acclaim and won Best Progressive R&B Album at the 66th Grammy Awards.
